caseNameFull: Isaac W. Fowler, Receiver, etc. v. John C. Osgood
summary: Appeals from the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Colorado.
attorneys: Mr. Joseph C. Helm and Mr. N. T. Guernsey for appellant. Mr. Cass E. Herrington and Mr. David C. Beaman for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Louisville Trust Company v. Knott, 195 U. S. 225, and cases

therein cited; Bache v. Hunt, 193 U. S. 523, 525.
